Owner Keiko emigrated from Japan to Vancouver where she opened a bakery; her sweet dream turned into a nightmare and now Steve will have to help her back on the path to success.
Bakers compete in a speedy elimination round using basil as their mystery ingredient; remaining two compete for $10,000 in a Viva Italia-themed donut showdown.
Couples compete in a speedy elimination round using grapefruit as the mystery ingredient; the remaining two teams compete for $10,000 in a breakfast in bed-themed cake showdown.
Asian fish, miso noodles and crunchy vegetables; ultimate pork tacos, spicy black beans and avocado garden salad.
Anna prepares a variety of fruit mousses and also demonstrates how they can be enjoyed on its own or as part of a grand dessert.

Chuck travels to Nipissing, where he learns how to build snares and hunt wild rabbit; during his visit, he meets Lana Chevrier, an Anishinaabe woman with a passion for cooking; Lana runs a local catering business that specializes in small game meats.

Chuck meets Norbert Fontaine, a skilled boat captain from the Innu community of Uashat Mak Mani-Utenam; Chuck joins Captain Fontaine and his sons on a snow crab fishing adventure, where he learns how to prepare bait for crab traps.
A home cook attempts to turn a cheat meal into a crowd-pleaser; Chef Danny Smiles spices things up with the za'atar in his fridge; breakfast for dinner.
James accompanies his father on a long journey after learning that his new friend Gideon has run away from home.
Laura endangers her health and the life of her unborn child when she fights to keep a newly planted fruit orchard alive.
John-Boy invites Gypsies to camp on the Waltons' land, despite dire predictions; guest Gregory Sierra.
John-Boy seeks city employment when a legal mix-up threatens the Waltons' lumber rights; guest Garry Walberg.
An illiterate woman (Lynn Hamilton) whose daughter is graduating from college asks John-Boy to teach her.
Laura and Albert decide to spark a romance between hard-drinking Toby Noe and straight-laced Amanda Jane Cooper.
Laura's joy over the imminent birth of her first child is shattered when Almanzo suffers a paralyzing stroke.
Almanzo refuses to exercise to regain the use of his legs until a storm levels his home; he realizes that Laura has given up hope too.
Mr. Edwards almost alienates the Ingalls when he stays with them after alcoholism ruins his marriage.
Caroline faces an agonizing decision when she agrees to help a childhood friend whose illness threatens the life of her newborn baby.
The faith of the Walton family is sorely tried when Olivia contracts polio, and the doctor says that she may never walk again.
Olivia tries a radical polio treatment developed by Sister Kenny of Australia.
John-Boy heads for a mountain cabin to write, but ends up delivering an old schoolmate's (Sissy Spacek) baby.
Planning a surprise for the family with the Baldwin sisters, Grandpa makes Grandma jealous.
A widow accuses John of stealing while he was working in her mansion; guest Dennis Dugan.
Widow Verdie Grant (Lynn Hamilton) seeks help to win an itinerant laborer (Hal Williams) with a young son.
Jack and Elizabeth's plan to get married is put in serious jeopardy; Bill has difficulty transporting a prisoner.
Ava accepts the opportunity of a lifetime to work at the Royal Ice Hotel, which leads to a surprise whirlwind romance with the most important guest of all, the prince himself.
Three families celebrate Christmas at turning points in their lives.

Marie finds her Christmas spirit reawakened when her mother begins sending her the family's Christmas ornaments. As each ornament arrives, it brings a positive change to Marie's life, including an introduction to the handsome man from next door.
A toy store data analyst tries to save hundreds of jobs right before Christmas to help keep the in-store experience alive.

Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.
